rejectionRules.noSignRule: If top1 class is NO_SIGN, never surface candidate.
rejectionRules.marginRule: top1 - top2 probability difference must be >= 0.10
rejectionRules.stabilityRule: Must observe 3 consecutive matching accepted windows before candidate is surfaced.

tuningSplit: Grouped sequence-level validation (122 sequences, 15%) on genuine signers (signer-01..signer-04)
rationale: Safest operating configuration selected from calibration sweep: suppresses NO_SIGN false activation to 18.75% (<20% target) with 97.20% precision, 98.11% recall, and ~1.03s latency.
